requirement: The system shall refuse to create an appointment that overlaps an existing appointment for the same attendee.
The system shall compute a list of free slots for an attendee between two dates, excluding existing appointments and outside working hours.
The user selects a time slot and invites attendees; the system creates the appointment, sends invitations and adds it to the calendar.
The system shall send a reminder to all attendees one hour before an appointment starts.
As an attendee, I want to see my day's schedule so that I know what is coming up.
As an event organiser, I want to create a recurring appointment that repeats weekly so that I do not have to create each occurrence manually.
A user may only view an appointment's details if they are an attendee or the organiser; others must be denied.
Every change to an appointment (create, edit, cancel, reschedule) must be logged with the previous values, the new values and the acting user.
The appointment table shall ensure that start time precedes end time, that the organiser is recorded, and that the status is one of the recognised values.
code:
-- appointment table for the calendar service
CREATE TABLE appointment (
    appointment_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    organiser_id    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    title           VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    starts_at       TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    ends_at         TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT appointment_times_order   CHECK (ends_at > starts_at),
    CONSTRAINT appointment_organiser_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(organiser_id)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT appointment_status_chk    CHECK (status IN ('TENTATIVE','CONFIRMED','CANCELLED')),
    CONSTRAINT appointment_title_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX appointment_organiser_idx ON appointment (organiser_id, starts_at);
CREATE INDEX appointment_starts_idx   ON appointment (starts_at);

-- attendee join table for appointments
CREATE TABLE appointment_attendee (
    appointment_id  BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    attendee_id     VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    response        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    CONSTRAINT attendee_appointment_fk FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointment(appointment_id),
    CONSTRAINT attendee_pk PRIMARY KEY (appointment_id, attendee_id),
    CONSTRAINT attendee_response_chk CHECK (response IN ('PENDING','ACCEPTED','DECLINED','TENTATIVE'))
);
-- room reservation table
CREATE TABLE room_reservation (
    reservation_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    room_id         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    appointment_id  BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    starts_at       TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    ends_at         TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT room_times_order CHECK (ends_at > starts_at),
    CONSTRAINT room_appointment_fk FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointment(appointment_id)
);
